items.source: Only used internally by this implementation.
items.translation: 仅由本实现内部使用。

items.source: In contrast to CookieLocaleResolver, this strategy stores locally chosen locale settings in the Servlet container's HttpSession. As a consequence, those settings are just temporary for each session and therefore lost when each session terminates.
items.translation: 与CookieLocaleResolver相反，此策略将用户本地选择的区域设置存储在 Servlet 容器的HttpSession中。因此，这些设置仅对每个会话临时有效，并在每个会话终止时丢失。

items.source: Note that there is no direct relationship with external session management mechanisms such as the "Spring Session" project. This LocaleResolver will simply evaluate and modify corresponding HttpSession attributes against the current HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 请注意，与外部会话管理机制（如"Spring Session"项目）之间没有直接关系。此LocaleResolver将简单地根据当前的HttpServletRequest评估并修改相应的HttpSession属性。

items.source: The default is an internal LOCALE_SESSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME.
items.translation: 默认值为内部LOCALE_SESSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME。

items.source: The default is an internal TIME_ZONE_SESSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME.
items.translation: 默认值为内部TIME_ZONE_SESSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME。

items.source: This is most appropriate if the application needs user sessions anyway, i.e. when the HttpSession does not have to be created just for storing the user's locale. The session may optionally contain an associated time zone attribute as well; alternatively, you may specify a default time zone.
items.translation: 如果应用程序本身就需要用户会话，即当不需要仅为了存储用户的区域设置而创建 `HttpSession` 时，这是最合适的方法。会话还可以可选地包含一个关联的时区属性；或者，您可以指定一个默认时区。

items.source:
Set the current locale context to the given one,
potentially including a locale with associated time zone information.
items.translation: 设置当前区域上下文为给定的一个，可能包含带有相关时区信息的区域。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Vedran Pavic
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller，Vedran Pavic

items.source: This is primarily intended for framework-level processing; consider using RequestContextUtils or RequestContext for application-level access to the current locale and/or time zone.
items.translation: 这主要用于框架级别的处理；如需在应用级别访问当前区域设置和/或时区，请考虑使用RequestContextUtils 或RequestContext。

items.source: Custom controllers can override the user's locale and time zone by calling #setLocale(Context) on the resolver, for example, responding to a locale change request. As a more convenient alternative, consider using RequestContext.changeLocale(Locale).
items.translation: 自定义控制器可以通过在解析器上调用#setLocale(Context)来覆盖用户的区域设置和时区，例如响应区域设置更改请求。作为一种更便捷的替代方案，请考虑使用RequestContext.changeLocale(Locale)。

items.source: The returned context may be a TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext, containing a locale with associated time zone information. Simply apply an instanceof check and downcast accordingly.
items.translation: 返回的上下文可能是`TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext`，其中包含带有关联时区信息的区域设置。只需应用一个 `instanceof` 检查并相应地进行向下转换即可。

items.source: The default implementation returns the configured default locale, if any, and otherwise falls back to the request's Accept-Language header locale or the default locale for the server.
items.translation: 默认实现会返回配置的默认区域设置（如果有），否则回退到请求的Accept-Language 标头区域设置或服务器的默认区域设置。

items.source: Use RequestContext(Utils).getLocale() to retrieve the current locale in controllers or views.
items.translation: 使用RequestContext(Utils).getLocale()在控制器或视图中获取当前区域设置。

items.source: Use RequestContext(Utils).getTimeZone() to retrieve the current time zone in controllers or views.
items.translation: 使用RequestContext(Utils).getTimeZone()在控制器或视图中获取当前时区。

items.source: The default implementation returns the configured default time zone, if any, or null otherwise.
items.translation: 默认实现返回配置的默认时区（如果有），否则返回 `null`。

items.source: Can return a default locale as fallback in any case.
items.translation: 在任何情况下都可以返回默认区域设置作为后备。

items.source:
Custom resolver implementations may also return extra settings in
the returned context, which again can be accessed through downcasting.
items.translation: 自定义解析器实现也可以在返回的上下文中返回额外的设置，这些设置同样可以通过向下转型进行访问。

items.source: Specify the name of the corresponding attribute in the HttpSession, holding the current Locale value.
items.translation: 指定 `HttpSession` 中用于存储当前 Locale 值的相应属性名称。

items.source: Specify the name of the corresponding attribute in the HttpSession, holding the current TimeZone value.
items.translation: 指定 `HttpSession` 中用于存储当前 TimeZone 值的相应属性名称。

items.source: Set the function used to determine the default locale for the given request, called if no Locale session attribute has been found.
items.translation: 设置用于确定给定请求默认区域设置的函数，如果在会话中未找到 `Locale` 会话属性，则调用该函数。

items.source: Set the function used to determine the default time zone for the given request, called if no TimeZone session attribute has been found.
items.translation: 设置用于确定给定请求的默认时区的函数，如果在未找到 `TimeZone` 会话属性时将调用该函数。

items.source: Default name of the session attribute that holds the Locale.
items.translation: 存储 Locale 的会话属性的默认名称。

items.source: Default name of the session attribute that holds the TimeZone.
items.translation: 存储时区的会话属性的默认名称。

items.source: Resolve the current locale via the given request.
items.translation: 通过给定的请求解析当前区域设置。

items.source: Resolve the current locale context via the given request.
items.translation: 通过给定的请求解析当前的区域设置上下文。

items.source: localeContext - the new locale context, or null to clear the locale
items.translation: localeContext - 新的区域设置上下文，或为 null 以清除区域设置

items.source: defaultLocaleFunction - the function used to determine the default locale
items.translation: defaultLocaleFunction - 用于确定默认区域设置的函数

items.source: defaultTimeZoneFunction - the function used to determine the default time zone
items.translation: defaultTimeZoneFunction - 用于确定默认时区的函数

items.translation: request - 用于解析区域设置的请求

items.translation: 当前区域设置（永远不为null）

items.translation: 当前区域设置上下文（永远不为null）
